critical_code_review_comments: OnboardingTutorial component rendered twice in both dashboards - works but could be cleaner. The first instance checks localStorage, the second is triggered by showOnboarding state. When help button is clicked, resetOnboarding() clears localStorage AND sets showOnboarding=true, so both conditions become true briefly.
The resetOnboarding export function is correctly used by help button to clear localStorage before showing tutorial again
